svg.title: Architecture: User → React Frontend → Django Backend ↔ Data stores
svg.desc: Left-to-right architecture with User, React/Vite frontend subgraph, Django REST backend subgraph (Django REST as primary, Auth and Audit as subordinates), and cylindrical data stores pointing back to Django REST.
